faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the JNCASR ARF Scientific Instrumentation Specialist (TEM) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 04 September 2026. It is advisable to apply well in advance to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the ARF Scientific Instrumentation Specialist (TEM) post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Sc. or equivalent degree in Chemistry/Physics or a BE/BTech degree with a minimum of 60% marks.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any experience required for this position?
faq.answer: While not mandatory, a minimum of 5 years of experience handling instruments at a central facility in a national/international research laboratory is desirable. Prior experience with Transmission Electron Microscope operation and maintenance is preferred.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for this post is 35 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the ARF Scientific Instrumentation Specialist (TEM) position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 479000 Per Annum, which is commensurate with experience.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for this job?
faq.answer: Applications need to be submitted via email. You should prepare your bio-data, attach necessary documents, and send it to the official email address mentioned in the notification before the last date.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the ARF Scientific Instrumentation Specialist (TEM) role?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve an Online Interview, Technical Discussion, and Personal Interaction.

faq.question: Q9. Where is JNCASR located?
faq.answer: Jawaharlal Nehru Centre For Advanced Scientific Research (JNCASR) is located in Bengaluru, Karnataka, with the pincode 560064.
